design.route: Increase independent queries per existing exact-attention slab from32 to128; preserve K16/K32 arithmetic, SFU tables, midpoint/error selection, fixed maximum1024 compact replay blocks and stream completion.
design.hypothesis: At32 queries the approximate PV stage launches only64 CTAs.128 queries supplies256 independent CTAs and reduces host synchronization count from256 to64 for q8192. This may improve completed q8192 wall by seconds; it is an unmeasured hypothesis.
design.applies_to: Global selective PV layouts22/24 with total key extent<=8192. Other layouts, decode and longer extents retain previous batching.
